_about: Resources govoss adds to /resources, in the same record shape as resources/ospo-resources.json (compiled by UN+NYC). Kept in a separate file so replacing theirs never drops these, and so these are never credited to them. Every record carries added_by: govoss. Records from the opensource.nyc OSPO research also carry reuse_role (framework = any city, example = a peer's example, local = one jurisdiction's own law or policy, named in jurisdiction) and exec_sections (the OSPO executive summary sections that CITE them, in a footnote or in the section's notes; empty when no section does). They have no use_for_ospo_construction yet, and verification_status listed: not yet checked against the source.
